Hi Camila,

We're in the middle of our renewal conversations for the Q4 commit and have a couple of parallel asks from Procurement and Security:

1) Security wants to confirm Redwood's latest attestation status and any SOC-like evidence we can share for our renewal (attestation date, controls changes, and sample logs/retention). Their explicit ask: can you provide a short evidence bundle and a recommended retention profile we should propose in the contract?

2) On the commercial side: we're looking to increase committed GPU capacity by ~2.5x starting Nov 1 and would like visibility on term discounts if we sign up for 12 months. We may also need slight changes to the log retention window for auditability.

Can you outline what you can share (documents, timeline) and whether the 12-month commitment can be combined with a retention amendment plus capacity uplift? Procurement has requested a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align calendars.

Attaching our current SOW for reference.

Thanks,
Mike

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear asks. High level plan below; details and attachments follow.

Summary (what we'll do):
- Provide a concise evidence bundle for HorizonAI within 10 business days (SoA summary, control mapping, sample control screenshots, sanitized audit log samples).
- Share two supported log-retention options with cost delta: 90 days (default) or 365 days (retention add-on).
- Prepare a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for procurement and a draft amendment that adds retention language to the master agreement.
- Commercial: offer a committed-capacity discount tier for a 12-month term. I'll loop in Marissa (CS) and Jonas (Infra) to size the uplift and finalize pricing. Vivek will validate the amendment language for retention/SLA.

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0 (today): Confirm scope and stakeholders (we have it).
- Day 3–7: Deliver evidence bundle + retention options (we'll provide redacted log samples and SoA summary).
- Day 7–14: Draft MAP + amendment + pricing proposal for capacity uplift.
- Day 14–21: DocuSign and signatures to meet Nov 1 start if you want the committed capacity live on that date.

I've attached: RI_SoA_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx (evidence checklist you'll receive) and log_retention_options.pdf (cost/latency implications).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm any additional auditor contacts (if you want us to coordinate directly with your auditor).
2) Confirm target committed GPU units and any hard cutover date.
3) Approve the timeline.

If that looks good I will create the MAP and Marissa will follow up on pricing.

Warmly,
Camila Reyes
